app Exact
Given
 contract Nested { amount:decimal, values:decimal[] }
 Amount { value:decimal=1.50, integral:decimal=42, optional:decimal?, nullableDefault:decimal?=2.00 }
 derive positive():decimal = 0001.50
 derive negative():decimal = -1.50
 derive zero():decimal = -0.00
 derive integer():decimal = 99999999999999999999999999999999999999
 derive fraction():decimal = 99999999999999999999.123456789012345678
 derive tiny():decimal = 0.000000000000000001
 derive optional():decimal? = 7
 derive whole():int = 42
 derive nested():Nested = {amount=3,values=[1.50,-2.00,4]}
 derive identity(value:decimal=1.50):decimal = value
 derive defaults():decimal = identity()
When
 scenario literal() read=true -> decimal by=members
  do
   return -1.50
 scenario mutate(value:decimal=2.50) -> decimal by=members
  do
   return value
